units: <cite ref="Berakhot 52b">Ber. 52ᵇ</cite> <he>סתם מְסִבַּת כותים לע״ז</he> (Ms. M. <he>הסבת גוים</he>) the banqueting of gentiles is presumed to be dedicated to idolatry.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 120a:4">B. Bath. 120ᵃ</cite> <he>במ׳ הלך אחר זקנה</he> in sitting down for a festive meal age takes the precedence.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 1:1">Tam. I, 1</cite> <he>מ׳ ההולכת וכ׳</he> the staircase leading (to a well) under the Temple.
